S01.label: Raw / Source
S01.definition: Unprocessed, original input in its most primitive form.  No extraction or transformation has occurred; the artifact is exactly as received from its origin.  Every intake starts here.

S02.label: Parsed / Extracted
S02.definition: Structure has been extracted from raw input; fields are identifiable. The artifact has been decomposed but not yet validated or cross-referenced against external evidence.

S03.label: Candidate

S06.label: Validated
S06.definition: Has passed applicable quality gates, link-integrity checks, and schema conformance.  Evidence receipts are present and linked; the artifact is reliable for downstream use but not yet canon.

S07.label: Evidence / Receipt

N01.label: Solid / Ground

N02.label: Liquid / Flow
N02.definition: Dynamic and adaptive.  Artifacts in flux, undergoing active revision or being transported between review states.  Active sprint items and in-progress documents are N02 nodes.

N03.label: Gas / Diffuse
